text.description_html:
Emtek 11B1, 2 x 10 Rectangular Multi Point Handleset with American Cylinder Below Handle

The Modern 2 x 10 Multi Point Handleset features Emtek's multipoint configuration # 1 which is designed to replace Andersen, Atrium, G-U, and Superior brand patio door trim among others. The American Cylinder is located below the lever and the center to center is 3-5/8 inches. It will fit doors 1-5/8 inches to 2-3/4 inches thick. Choose from a wide array of modern finishes and contemporary levers. The 2 x 10 Rectangular Multi Point Handleset with American Cylinder Below Handle is available in several functions so you'll be able to find one to suit your needs.

This multipoint trim set is intended to replace the trim from Atrium®, G-U®, KML by Andersen®, Andersen®, Marvin Integrity®, Paddock Lockmaster, Superior® brand patio doors. The lock to lever distance is 3-5/8" (92 mm). This set does not come packaged with the multipoint lock mechanism (the vertical rods found in multipoint patio doors that secure the door to the frame) as those are typically preinstalled in multipoint doors and cannot be replaced.

Features and Specifications of the Brass Modern Multi Point Trim with Door Configuration #1:

  • Material: Brass
  • Overall Height: 10"
  • Overall Width: 2"
  • Distance Between Trim and Cylinder or Thumbturn (for Keyed, Passage, and Patio Functions): 3-5/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 7-9/16"
  • Plate Thickness: 3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-5/8" - 2-3/4" please specify.
  • Solid steel spindle.
  • Emtek 11B1 Dimensions (PDF)

Available Functions:

  • Dummy Pair, Active (inside): Active lever inside with fixed inactive lever outside. For use as a pull or to match trim. Normally used on inactive French door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles and mounting screws.
  • Dummy Pair, Inactive: Fixed inactive levers both sides of door. For use as a pull or to match trim. Normally used on inactive French door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles and mounting screws.
  • Passage: Active levers both sides of door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, and mounting screws.
  • Patio: Active levers both sides of door. Thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, One (1) interior thumb turn and mounting screws.
  • Keyed Entry: Active levers both sides of door. Keyed lock cylinder outside with thumb turn inside to lock door. Set includes: Two (2) backplates, Two (2) levers with spindles, Two (2) cylinder collars, One (1) american profile cylinder with key outside & thumb turn inside and mounting screws.

Choose any of the different levers to complete your handleset.
